gate.affected: direct tier (xtask bounded set) on keke n3: see gate-test-time-gate-3

informational: Pass 2 (exports interposed) ~2x slower since train 37a467944 (11-14 23:45): test-seconds ~4800 -> ~9700, wall ~285 -> ~525 s on the CI host; coincides with TB-FOREIGN-WORDS-LOW (a thread block libniji did not make keeps no heap cache). strstr_find pass2/pass1 in one gate 3.5x -> 7.4x, heap_threads 4x. Inferred from 160 CI gates, not A/B verified; belongs to the heap/TB stories.

Pass 1 math accuracy sweeps (complex_ld_cr, complex_f128, special_ld, special_f128: ~7300 test-s) run whenever any libniji byte changes (verdict cache D-10.57 by design); the 11-12 baseline was a cache hit. Since 11-13 nearly every train misses; pass 1 is ~300-390 s cached vs ~630-1480 s missed. Cheaper sweeps would be a math story.

Brief step 1 (re-run both suites at b31418181 and head on a quiet role) replaced by per-test timings from 160 CI gate logs on the CI host: the re-run is two FULL runs (forbidden) and one pair cannot separate cache hits from regressions.
Run deviation: two Bash heredocs were used for local scratch scripting (an empty one, then a python edit script) before switching to written files; no repository effect.
